authoredInterpretation.roofMethod: Piecewise interpreted hipped ranges clipped to native outer/court polygons. Coplanar roof faces merged before triangulation; vertical transitions face outward from taller ranges. Separate aligned west/east front pavilion hips; exact small valleys/flashings are not surveyed.
authoredInterpretation.permanentDetails: Four real pointed front recesses with back doors, two three-arch open loggias with Tuscan columns,11 principal paired groups plus smaller loggia middle light,3 separate basement lights/3 offset doors, stepped close-view Moorish parapet teeth. Fine historic carving/heraldry replaced by original abstract geometry.
authoredInterpretation.distanceLevels: Skyline keeps native massing, chimney silhouettes and all4 own court floors. District uses applied minor panes/coarser cusp/round profiles. Street retains principal recesses with triangular tooth proxies. Close restores stepped teeth, denser original carved/wood-frame details.
